Name: (CP) Dacar style portraits for Male Bachelorettes - Female Genderbend
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=4]This took me longer than I thought it would ngl[/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4]HD portraits for my own genderbend mod! This one includes the portraits for all the current outfits of the original mod! I'll probably work on a seasonal version some time in the future, but it's not a priority rn, I have other stuff I want to do before that (like Wedding Reception pics for this one).[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*
Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.
In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:

-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP

-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:
"active": "HDP" 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size][/color]
